recent_history.reading_theme: How adaptive reuse can create housing while preserving local character and preventing displacement
recent_history.writing_prompt: Some people think governments should subsidize the conversion of empty offices and commercial buildings into housing. Others believe public money should be used only to build new homes. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
recent_history.speaking_cue_card: Describe an old building that could be given a new use. You should say where it is, what it was used for, what new purpose it could have, and explain why the change would be beneficial.

recent_history.reading_theme: How restorative justice can repair harm while preserving accountability and community safety
recent_history.writing_prompt: Some people think prison is the best way to reduce crime. Others believe community-based rehabilitation is more effective for many offenders. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
recent_history.speaking_cue_card: Describe a community program that could help reduce crime. You should say what the program would be, who would participate, what activities it would include, and explain why it could be effective.

recent_history.reading_theme: How employers can reduce avoidable fatigue while preserving individual responsibility for healthy sleep
recent_history.writing_prompt: Some people think employers should be legally required to protect workers from sleep deprivation and fatigue. Others believe sleep is entirely a personal responsibility. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
recent_history.speaking_cue_card: Describe a time when better sleep improved your performance. You should say when it happened, what problem you had, what changes you made, and explain how your performance improved.

recent_history.reading_theme: How cities can reduce extreme heat through equitable neighborhood cooling and community-informed planning
recent_history.writing_prompt: Some people think city governments should require property owners to install cool roofs and plant trees to reduce urban heat. Others believe these actions should remain voluntary. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
recent_history.speaking_cue_card: Describe an environmental project that could improve your neighborhood. You should say what it is, where it would happen, who would benefit, and explain why it would be useful.

recent_history.reading_theme: How fair migration partnerships can spread skills, investment, and opportunity across origin and destination countries
recent_history.writing_prompt: Some people believe wealthy countries should actively recruit skilled workers from poorer countries. Others think this practice is unfair because it causes brain drain. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
recent_history.speaking_cue_card: Describe a program that could help migrants use their skills. You should say what the program is, where it would operate, what support it would provide, and explain why it would be useful.

recent_history.reading_theme: How inclusive community sport can improve health and social connection without creating excessive performance pressure
recent_history.writing_prompt: Some people think governments should spend more public money on community sports facilities. Others believe cultural and artistic programs should receive equal or greater funding. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
recent_history.speaking_cue_card: Describe a community sports or arts program you would like to join. You should say what it is, where it would take place, what you would do, and explain why you would like to join it.
